deadline.value: Apply by December 1 (2026) for Fall 2027; this is also the deadline for assistantship consideration.
deadline.quote: The application deadline is December 1 for a fall term start (no spring admissions). | To be considered for financial assistantship, all required application materials listed below should be submitted via the online application by the December 1 deadline.

gre_subject.value: No GRE Subject Test exists for this field; ETS offers Subject Tests only in Mathematics, Physics and Psychology.
gre_subject.quote: The GRE Subject Tests in Mathematics, Physics and Psychology measure undergraduate achievement in a particular field of study

supervisor.value: The department does not do pre-evaluations by email; no advisor rule for applicants is stated.

funding.value: The department strives to fund PhD students as TAs, RAs or PAs; admitted students can apply for TA positions, and December 1 applicants are considered for funding.
funding.quote: Students admitted to the PhD Statistics: Statistics option will have the opportunity to apply for teaching assistantships within the Department of Statistics.

also.quote: The department strives to support students in the PhD program as teaching, research, or project assistants.

entry_route.value: Apply from a bachelor's in a natural science, social science or engineering with a strong maths background.
entry_route.quote: Applicants holding a bachelor's degree with a natural science, social science, or engineering major and strong mathematical background are encouraged to apply for admission to the graduate program in statistics.

english_waiver.value: A test is needed unless your undergraduate instruction was in English (Graduate School rules apply).
english_waiver.quote: Applicants whose native language is not English, or whose undergraduate instruction was not in English, must provide an English proficiency test score.

notes: Apply to either the Statistics or the Biostatistics named option (not both); students can switch after enrolling.
